title: Zesty Fermented Jamaican Celery Hash
description: A fermented, fluffy, and flavorful Jamaican dish featuring celery, perfect for a vegan-friendly meal. This recipe combines the bold flavors of Jamaican spices with the crunch of celery.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine chopped celery, scotch bonnet peppers, onion, garlic, thyme, and allspice.
Mix well and let it sit at room temperature for 24 hours to start the fermentation process.
After 24 hours, add nutritional yeast and apple cider vinegar to the mixture and stir well.
Transfer the mixture to a wooden board and shape into a hash.
Let it ferment for another 24 hours, or until it reaches the desired level of fermentation.
Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat and add a small amount of oil.
Add the fermented celery hash to the skillet and cook until it is lightly browned and crispy.
Garnish with fresh thyme and scotch bonnet peppers, if desired.
